reason: I would try the free dishes and maybe the Sunday plan, since 40 baht a meal is interesting, but I already cook green curry and basil pork without an app. I will not pay 99 baht ahead for a pack that does not exist yet when the free part might be enough for me.
objection: Will the dish really come out right in my kitchen with my pan and my market's ingredients? I have to see it work with my own cooking before I pay anything, and paying now for something delivered later feels risky.
would_change_my_mind: If I cooked two or three of the free dishes and my family said they tasted better than usual, and the Sunday plan really kept my spending near 40 baht a meal, I would pay 99 baht once the pack is ready, not before.
